title: Plan OD-8/R1004: record the video description at fetch, match it at selection
body:
Plan for **OD-8**/`R1004`, written by the steward worker the unattended delivery driver dispatched on base `run/web`. Slug `description-signal`, `covers: [R1004]`, 394 lines.

The pipeline reads titles and transcripts and nothing else, so a board named only in a video's description is invisible to selection — the evidence in `BL-11`. The plan records the description at fetch and matches it at selection.

**No uncertainty is filed, and the plan says so explicitly** rather than leaving the section blank: *"None: every decision derived from the design."* It also carries a separate `Derivations, not uncertainties` section setting out the choices it derived and from what, so the empty list can be checked rather than taken on trust. That is the AGENTS.md branch for a plan with nothing to escalate — "a gate that fires when it has nothing to report trains people to click through it".

Opened by the server-side `open-pr` workflow at the driver's request (ESC-50).
